dataset_title: Local Land Charges Register / Search for local land charges
resource_title: Official public terms for Local Land Charges search inputs, access and boundary outputs
data_date: Official HM Land Registry terms page accessed 2026-10-06
license: Terms-page content is available under Open Government Licence v3.0 except where stated; underlying service information is subject to Crown copyright/database rights and Ordnance Survey/third-party terms.

field_evidence.search_inputs: HM Land Registry states the Local Land Charges service can search by postcode, address or partial address, map, title number, coordinates or INSPIRE ID.
field_evidence.personal_search: The terms page states a personal search is free and allows inspection of the Local Land Charges register.
field_evidence.official_search_geometry: The official search includes a search boundary/area on a map and local land charge boundary.
field_evidence.account_gate: The terms page states an account must be created to access the search service.
field_evidence.target_result_limit: The public/no-login terms page does not return a Forge Cottage TN25 7JX target result, title number, INSPIRE ID, or registered-title polygon.
field_evidence.geometry_limit: Search-area and local-land-charge boundaries are local-land-charge/search extents, not a registered-title cadastral parcel polygon.
field_evidence.parcel_promotion_rule: Without a target-specific authoritative registered-title/title-boundary polygon, no canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is promoted.
